Keep everything. Replace the temporary map and wave with data, and add the wave flow, selling and the economy. Add these sections to game_spec.json:
{"input":{"bindings":{"up":{"keys":["ArrowUp","KeyW"]},"down":{"keys":["ArrowDown","KeyS"]},"left":{"keys":["ArrowLeft","KeyA"]},"right":{"keys":["ArrowRight","KeyD"]},"selectCell":{"keys":[],"pointer":"cellTap"},"place":{"keys":["Enter"],"pointer":"cellTap"},"tower1":{"keys":["Digit1","Numpad1"],"pointer":"towerButton"},"tower2":{"keys":["Digit2","Numpad2"],"pointer":"towerButton"},"sell":{"keys":["KeyX","Delete","Backspace"],"pointer":"sellButton"},"nextWave":{"keys":["Space","KeyN"],"pointer":"waveButton"}}},"rules":{"sellRefund":0.7,"autoStartDelay":20,"earlyStartBonus":2,"waveBonus":25,"wavePoints":100,"basePoints":50},"levels":[{"id":"map1","startCoins":120,"baseHp":20,"path":[[4,-1],[4,1],[1,1],[1,4],[7,4],[7,7],[1,7],[1,10],[4,10],[4,12]],"blocked":[[0,0],[8,0],[0,11],[8,11]],"waves":[{"groups":[{"enemy":"basic","count":8,"interval":1,"delay":0}]},{"groups":[{"enemy":"basic","count":12,"interval":0.8,"delay":0}]},{"groups":[{"enemy":"fast","count":10,"interval":0.6,"delay":0}]},{"groups":[{"enemy":"basic","count":10,"interval":0.7,"delay":0},{"enemy":"fast","count":6,"interval":0.5,"delay":3}]},{"groups":[{"enemy":"tank","count":3,"interval":2,"delay":0},{"enemy":"basic","count":10,"interval":0.6,"delay":2}]},{"groups":[{"enemy":"fast","count":16,"interval":0.4,"delay":0}]},{"groups":[{"enemy":"tank","count":6,"interval":1.5,"delay":0},{"enemy":"fast","count":10,"interval":0.5,"delay":4}]},{"groups":[{"enemy":"tank","count":8,"interval":1.2,"delay":0},{"enemy":"basic","count":16,"interval":0.4,"delay":3},{"enemy":"fast","count":12,"interval":0.4,"delay":8}]}]}],"difficulty":{"hpScale":[{"at":1,"value":1},{"at":8,"value":2.2}]},"limits":{"enemies":60,"projectiles":80,"towers":108,"particles":96,"popups":16},"audio":{"sfx":{"place":{"wave":"square","freq":330,"freqEnd":440,"duration":0.08,"volume":0.3},"sell":{"wave":"sine","freq":660,"freqEnd":330,"duration":0.12,"volume":0.3},"shoot":{"wave":"triangle","freq":900,"freqEnd":700,"duration":0.04,"volume":0.12},"boom":{"wave":"noise","freq":0,"duration":0.15,"volume":0.3},"leak":{"wave":"sawtooth","freq":220,"freqEnd":160,"duration":0.15,"volume":0.35},"waveStart":{"wave":"triangle","freq":392,"freqEnd":784,"duration":0.3,"volume":0.35},"denied":{"wave":"square","freq":180,"freqEnd":150,"duration":0.1,"volume":0.25}}}}
Route every control through these input bindings (same keys and gestures as before, plus sell and nextWave).

LEVEL DATA
Use levels[0]: startCoins, baseHp, path (validate: consecutive nodes must share a row or a column; invalid = debug error and a straight vertical fallback path down the middle column), blocked cells (unbuildable, drawn neutral). Remove the temporary values.

WAVES
waves[i].groups: {enemy, count, interval, delay}. A wave starts all its groups together; each group waits delay s, then spawns count enemies every interval s at the path start. Enemy hp at spawn = hp * curve(difficulty.hpScale, waveNumber) (linear interpolation of {at, value}, hold last; at = wave number). If the enemy pool is full, delay that spawn to the next step (never skip enemies).
Wave cleared (all spawned, none alive): coins += waveBonus, score += wavePoints * waveNumber, then build phase, or win after the last wave.

BUILD PHASE
Between waves (and before wave 1) an auto-start timer counts rules.autoStartDelay s (0 = manual only). nextWave (Space/N or the Next wave button) starts the wave now and gives floor(timeLeft * earlyStartBonus) coins. nextWave is ignored during a wave. Building and selling are allowed in both phases.

SELL
When the cursor is on a tower, the bottom bar shows a Sell button with the refund; sell (X/Delete/Backspace or the button) gives coins += floor(cost * sellRefund) and removes the tower. Its projectiles in flight still resolve.

END AND SCORE
Base HP <= 0 -> RESULT lose immediately (checked before the win). Last wave cleared with base HP > 0 -> RESULT win, score += baseHp * basePoints. Score = enemy points + wave points (+ base bonus on win); sendScore(floor(score)), best = same value. Save progress {bestWave}.
Rewards and points are granted once per enemy, even with two lethal hits in the same step (dead flag).

SOUNDS
place on build, sell on sell, denied when a build fails, shoot on fire (at most one shoot sound per 0.05 s overall), boom on splash impact, destroy on kill, leak on leak, waveStart when a wave starts.

POOLS
Enemies, projectiles, towers, particles and popups sized by limits; projectiles alive more than 3 s are recycled; skipped projectiles when the pool is full.
Check: play the 8 waves with debug.invincible (base never loses HP): groups, delays, hpScale, auto-start, early bonus and selling all work, no frame drop with 40 towers.
